title: Work-history log introduced
description: Every accepted plan is now logged in docs/work-history.md.

title: Leveringsvolgorde screen
description: Put the delivery locations in tour order with drag and drop; the order is saved in terreinpositie.

title: Leveringsvolgorde: saved vs new number and Kaart
description: Shows the saved number next to the new one, plus a ground-plan map with numbered locations and the route.

title: Leveringsvolgorde: description, name and zone on the lines
description: Lines and map tooltip show description, name and zone instead of name, zone and distributiepunt.

title: Leveringsvolgorde: tour column on the left
description: The tour moved to the left, the locations not in the tour to the right.

title: Planningsanalyses group and Initiële leverplanning
description: New menu group with a first screen: the karren to deliver per afleverlocatie, in tour order.

title: Initiële leverplanning: grouped by distributiepunt
description: Grouped by distributiepunt first, then afleverlocatie in tour order, then karren.

title: Initiële leverplanning: selection and PDF with route map
description: Checkboxes with Shift range and a landscape PDF for the driver, optionally with a route map.

title: Leverroute map: zoom and legend
description: The PDF map zooms in on the printed points; the legend shows description and zone.

title: Initiële leverplanning: column filters
description: Filter row under the headings: a Status dropdown and text filters per column.

title: Verplaatsingen tussen festivals
description: Lists the karren to move between two festivals, grouped per pick-up location, with a PDF and optional map.

title: Speciale levertoeren
description: New tour master data, a Levertoeren field on MasterData's team fiche and a planning screen with PDF.

title: Speciale levertoeren-planning: stops and working route map
description: The PDF map was nearly empty; the tour now has its own numbered stops, without distributiepunten.

title: Product master data moved from MasterData to StockMaster
description: Producten, Type, Magazijnen, Categorieën and Limieten moved to StockMaster's Masterdata menu, with new rights.

title: Karcode Simulator and Instellingen
description: Calculator-style screen for a kar's lock code, plus an admin-editable karcode formula.

title: Karcode Simulator in the phone app
description: The simulator on the phone, for people with the right; the kar number can be scanned from its QR code or typed.

title: Karcode Simulator: scan uses the last 3 digits
description: Only the last 3 digits of a scanned QR value are used.

title: Block 1: Masterdata
description: Article catalogue, sizes with a fit, XLSX upload and download, KPI counts.

title: Block 2: Reservations and Voorbereiden
description: Persons per team and festival, size estimates, totals per day and a picklist PDF.

title: Ploegpakketten merged into Reservaties
description: The package is now per festival and entered on one page; the Ploegpakketten screen is gone.

title: KPI: teams forgotten at a festival
description: Flags a team with persons at one festival of the season and nothing at another.

title: Block 3: Stock
description: Receipt, washing, write-off, count, undo, Te bestellen and a minimum-stock warning.

title: Block 4: counter desk
description: Hand-out and return at the counter, starting with the Ophalen / Terugbrengen choice.

title: Desk: first and family name, bracelet number
description: The person is identified by first and family name; email is no longer unique; bracelet number added.

title: Desk: optional articles, clear still-has box, return warning
description: Uitgeven stayed disabled and a second pick-up was refused unclearly; articles are optional and the reason is shown.

title: Block 5: wristband scans via webhook and Test-scan
description: Public webhook for the wristband company, scanners per desk, and a screen to simulate scans.

title: Documentation update
description: Handbooks, module help manuals and technical setup refreshed, with new screenshots.

title: XLSX import of an export from another environment; festival box width
description: Articles exported on localhost gave 'id not found' on test; rows now fall back to the natural key.

title: Desk: message for an article without sizes
description: An article without sizes now shows a clear message at the desk.

title: Desk mails, Openstaand grouped, Reservaties progress
description: Mails after Uitgifte and Inname with editable texts, bigger desk buttons, column filters and festivals filled in per team.

title: Masked emails and wash statistics
description: Email addresses are masked on screen (GDPR); washed clothes per day, festival and year on the KPI page.

title: Team leads behind an icon on Ophalen; no email column on Openstaand
description: The team's ploegverantwoordelijken open from a contact icon; Openstaand has no email column any more.

title: Voice count of a kar on the phone (phase 1)
description: Scan a kar, choose Ophalen or Terugbrengen and count by voice; saved counts don't change stock yet.

title: Voice count on iPhone home-screen app
description: The microphone gave no text on iPhone; added tap to start/stop and a dictation box.

title: Voice count: spoken product aliases and expected products
description: Parked plan for better product matching in the voice count.

title: Wijzigingen screen for the super admin
description: Read-only list of all updates, corrections and new functionalities, the same on localhost, test and production.

title: Kar Map: icons instead of colour dots
description: Each layer of the Kar Map has its own icon on the switches and pins, for people who cannot tell the colours apart.

title: Search in every dropdown
description: Every dropdown list on the website and the phone app gets a search box.

title: Return status per piece
description: The desk can note per returned piece why it is a problem, from a list kept in Masterdata, with an overview of those pieces.

title: Read the wristband QR code with the PC camera
description: A camera icon next to the wristband number reads its QR code when the wristband scanners are not working.

title: Inname from the Openstaand screen
description: A return can be booked per person directly from the Openstaand list.

title: Excel download on Openstaand and Retourproblemen
description: Both screens can download what they show as an Excel file, without email addresses.

title: TagScan becomes Scans, with wristbands as a shared part
description: TagScan is renamed to Scans with separate RFID and wristband parts, wristband messages are kept as JSON files and a table, scans only show at a counter when the team has reservations, and the webhook token is generated in the settings with an explanation PDF for the wristband company.

title: Team aliases
description: A team can have alternative names so wristband scans with a slightly different team name still match it.

title: Openstaand and Retourproblemen over all festivals
description: Openstaand and Retourproblemen can show every festival of the season at once, with a Festival column to filter per festival.

title: Mass test with last year's data
description: A runner loads last year's Excel lists through the API on localhost, test and production (starting with Atelier Uitgifte/Inname, with back-dated bookings) and logs every row that fails with a description and a proposed solution.

title: Raspberry Pi app for Uitgifte/Inname with RFID tags
description: A stand-alone touch app on the Raspberry Pi books Atelier hand-outs and returns live in RWCrew by reading the pieces' RFID tags after the wristband scan.
